title: SIMPPLE's Singapore Subsidiaries Receive Green 100 Badge at TR 149 Essential Level
summary: IFSC Pte. Ltd. and Gaussian Robotics Pte. Ltd. receive the Singapore Environment Council’s Green 100 badge at TR 149 Essential level, Singapore’s national standard for environmental sustainability.
body_markdown:
We are pleased to share that our Singapore subsidiaries IFSC Pte. Ltd. and Gaussian Robotics Pte. Ltd. have each received the Green 100 badge at TR 149 Essential level, verified and issued by the Singapore Environment Council.


TR 149:2026 is Singapore’s national Technical Reference for environmental sustainability excellence. It was launched in May 2026 by Enterprise Singapore through the Singapore Standards Council.


The framework gives organisations a structured way to assess their sustainability maturity and measure progress over time. It covers five areas: people readiness, structure, operations, supply network and product life cycle.


There are four levels: Essential, Bronze, Silver and Gold. Each step up requires progressively greater sustainability maturity across all five areas.


Green 100 is the national movement that supports broader adoption of TR 149 among Singapore SMEs. It was launched by the Council for a Competitive Climate Transition, established by the National Climate Change Secretariat and the Singapore Business Federation.


Essential is the first of those four levels. It gives IFSC and Gaussian Robotics an assessed baseline across the five areas.


We are treating the Essential level as a starting point rather than a result.


Our thanks to the Singapore Environment Council and to the Green 100 programme.
